title: Restore shipped default product drafts with one-click reset and safer generation errors

requirements.summary: Add a visible workspace control to restore the three shipped default products by clearing local drafts and repopulating the editor from DEFAULT_PRODUCTS.
acceptanceCriteria: ProductsWorkspace shows a clearly labeled control (e.g., "Restore default products")
Clicking the control removes any saved local drafts (using the existing localDrafts reset capability) and immediately repopulates the editor with the three DEFAULT_PRODUCTS entries
After reset, the visible product names match exactly: "Digital Planner Mastery", "Canva Templates Empire", and "Printable Wall Art Studio"

file_operations.description: Add a clearly labeled "Restore default products" action to the Product Editor workspace that clears local drafts (via the existing resetDrafts capability) and repopulates in-memory products from shipped defaults (not from localStorage), ensuring the three product names match the DEFAULT_PRODUCTS entries.

Add an exported helper (e.g., a factory like getDefaultProducts()) that returns a fresh copy of the shipped DEFAULT_PRODUCTS so restores do not reuse mutated references and the workspace repopulates reliably from shipped defaults.

requirements.summary: Add a confirmation prompt before restoring defaults and ensure the workspace returns to the first product tab after confirming.
acceptanceCriteria: Attempting to restore defaults prompts the user to confirm the destructive action
Confirm performs the reset and switches the workspace to the first product tab (product-1)

file_operations.description: Wrap the restore-defaults action in a confirmation step (English-only text) so users must confirm before drafts are wiped; on cancel, do nothing; on confirm, perform the reset and force the active tab to product-1 (calling onActiveProductChange when provided and/or using internal state as needed).

requirements.summary: Ensure bundle generation uses restored in-memory product data after reset and improve PDF/ZIP failure messages to be specific and actionable in English.
acceptanceCriteria: After restoring defaults, generating a single product produces a bundle without requiring any backend product data
If PDF generation throws, the UI error includes the product number and indicates the user should verify required fields (name, subtitle, description) are present (English-only)
If ZIP generation throws, the UI error indicates ZIP creation failed and to retry (English-only)

file_operations.description: Ensure the restore flow sets products state to a fresh in-memory copy so subsequent Generate actions use restored product data; update single-product generation error handling to (1) include the product number and (2) show actionable English-only messages: for PDF failures instruct verifying required fields (name, subtitle, description); for ZIP failures state ZIP creation failed and instruct retry.

Harden generation error surfacing by ensuring thrown errors clearly distinguish PDF generation vs ZIP generation failures (so the UI can reliably map them to the required actionable messages) while keeping generation fully frontend-only and based on the provided in-memory product entry.
